name: Cove-50 printed FDM body
scope: The selected robot: the complete 3D-printed FDM body with its connectors, the integrated electronics and the selected actuators. Selection does not qualify physical behaviour.

Lower body (FDM connectors).scope: Selected 6-stage bilateral 3D-printed FDM lower-body connector architecture (Stages 1-6: Shin, Ankle Coupler, Foot Monocoque, Thigh, Hip Pitch-to-Roll, Hip Yaw-to-Pitch) with 64 pressed-in 304 SS compression sleeves per leg, 3D bevels/G1 fillets, and integrated 2-screw/panel hard-shell mounts (including side-by-side front mounts on Stage 1 Shin for shin_front). Physical print, bolt preload retention, cyclic fatigue, and learned-control qualification remain separate.

Upper body / arm (FDM connectors).scope: Selected 4-stage bilateral 3D-printed FDM arm connector architecture (Stages 1-4: Shoulder Pitch-to-Roll, Shoulder Roll-to-Yaw, Upper-Arm Yaw-to-Elbow, Forearm Elbow-to-Wrist) with 34 pressed-in 304 SS compression sleeves per arm (68 bilateral), 4 forearm M3x8 captive-nut hard-shell mounts per arm (8 bilateral = 38 bolted connections/arm, 76 bilateral), full 3D asymmetric edge beveling (r_inner > r_outer), overhauled C-channel Stage 1 bridge with flush 3.00 mm pitch horn hub and zero floating shoulder shell screws, and down-first wrap-around Stage 3 upper-arm routing for easy fabric covering. Neck / head (FDM connectors).scope: Selected 4-stage 3D-printable FDM neck & head connector architecture (Stage 1 Neck Root Cradle, Stage 2 Yaw-to-Pitch L-Link, Stage 3 Pitch-to-Head Right-Side U-Cradle, Stage 4 Consolidated Head Sensor/Compute/Mic Carrier) with 34 pressed-in 304 SS compression sleeves (6+8+6+14), asymmetric 3D edge bevels (r_inner > r_outer), 0.0000 mm^3 overlap across all 29 yaw x pitch poses and 4 exterior shells, and matched 3D tetrahedral Gmsh FEM across PAHT-CF dry/wet and PETG-CF. Complete body (FDM integration).scope: The complete 3D-printed FDM body refitted to the owner-locked three-tier motor set (robot/model/motor-map/motor-map.json): Waveshare ST3025 at hip pitch, knee and ankle pitch (fast-leg tier, 6); Feetech STS3250 at hip roll, shoulders and elbows (strong tier, 10); Feetech ST3215-C047 at hip yaw and ankle roll (light tier); the neck keeps its XM335 pair. Hips +4 mm per side, knees and ankles about 14 mm wider, lower-pelvis cells laid horizontally on the midline. Printed structure 476.3 -> 492.0 g; leg and arm servos 1100 -> 1685 g. Physical print, press-fit retention, bolt preload and learned-control transfer remain separate.

body_manifest_chain: The selected body = the roll-flip body (artifacts/robot/body/ape-proportions/shell-pass/assembly-parts-roll-flip.json, built by robot/body/leg/roll_flip_checks.py) with the shoulder U connectors applied by robot/body/arm/shoulder_clevis.py manifest. After the roll-flip body is regenerated, run `.venv/bin/python -B robot/body/arm/shoulder_clevis.py manifest` to carry the change into the selected body. When the arm's joint frames or the roll servo placement change in the roll-flip body, first rerun `.venv/bin/python -B robot/body/arm/shoulder_clevis.py build` (the U connectors and their sleeves are built against those frames), then `manifest`. Then `python3 infra/tools/memguard.py --limit-gb 6 --timeout-s 1800 -- .venv/bin/python -B robot/body/arm/shoulder_shells.py apply` writes the selected body (parametric upper-arm covers around the green U, round torso openings about the pitch axes; owner selected 2026-11-22).
